label: جود — نجدية
ref_text: الله يعطيك العافية. رقم جوالك المسجل عندنا وش يكون؟ عشان أقدر أتحقق من هويتك
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_mix_v3/wavs/c1530756413e.wav (id najdi_v3_c1530756413e: in the v3 test split, so the shipped najdi_mix_v3_ft checkpoint never trained on it)
notes: Joud ('Joud - Saudi Gentle & Warm', a synthesiser voice), the Najdi female support agent: with Nasser, one of the two voices the omnivoice_najdi model trained on (8,276 of her clips, 10.3 h). An agent asking for the caller's number, at her natural pace. Picked from the 178 held-out Joud clips of 5-9 s: the ten best by their own quality were each cloned on eight unseen sentences with the shipped model, and this one gave the most Joud-like clones (similarity 0.874, the next 0.865) with the highest UTMOS (3.11, next 3.07) at 0.97x her natural pace.
